google_review_notes: Kids app for ages 4-8 (Designed for Families). No login, no accounts, no chat. Every purchase, Restore purchases and the privacy-policy link sit behind a parental gate: tap the lock (top corner of the home screen) and PRESS AND HOLD the correct answer to the multiplication shown (e.g. 7 x 8 = 56) for about 1.5 seconds. Free content: counting, comparing, plus and minus with numbers up to 10. full_pack unlocks the numbers 11 to 20 and removes ads; remove_ads removes the banner only. Ads: AdMob banner only, child-directed (TFCD, TFUA, max rating G), never on play screens; no interstitial or rewarded ads, no notifications, no Play Games, no Firebase.
apple_review_notes: Kids app for ages 4-8. No login. Purchases and links are behind a parental gate: tap the lock on the home screen and press and hold the correct answer to the multiplication shown. Free: numbers up to 10; the one-time Numbers up to 20 purchase unlocks 11 to 20.
